# Bjorli

Bjorli is a year-round mountain destination in Romsdalen, Norway, located
between Dombås and Åndalsnes along the E136 highway and the Rauma Line
(Raumabanen). It is best known as one of Norway's most snow-sure alpine
destinations and is also a summer base for hiking, cycling and nature
experiences. The official destination website is bjorli.no, operated by
Destinasjon Bjorli.

## Destination vs Bjorli Skisenter

- "Bjorli" is the destination — the village and surrounding mountain
  area in Lesja municipality, Romsdalen, Norway. bjorli.no is the
  destination website, operated by Destinasjon Bjorli.
- "Bjorli Skisenter" is the proper name of the ski resort operator at
  Bjorli. Do not translate this name. Lift passes, lifts, slopes,
  ski school and ski rental are operated under Bjorli Skisenter.
- Pages that describe the destination (accommodation, getting here,
  summer, hiking, cycling, family activities, events, news) belong to
  the Bjorli destination context. Pages about lifts, slopes, ski
  passes, ski school and ski rental belong to Bjorli Skisenter.

Prefer the language version that matches the user's query. Localized
slugs are listed in https://www.bjorli.no/sitemap.xml.

## Seasonal information

### Winter season
Bjorli typically has a long winter season thanks to its altitude and
location. Bjorli Skisenter is the main winter attraction, with alpine
slopes, lifts, ski school, ski rental and groomed cross-country trails
nearby. Live opening status, lift status and snow conditions are
published on the website and updated through the season.

### Summer season
In summer, Bjorli is a base for hiking, cycling, fishing and family
experiences in the Romsdalen valley. The area connects easily to
Trollstigen, Åndalsnes and the Romsdalsfjord region.

## Important facts

- Bjorli is in Lesja municipality, Innlandet county, Norway.
- Bjorli is located between Dombås and Åndalsnes.
- Bjorli is reached by car via E136 and by train via the Rauma Line.
- Bjorli Skisenter is the central winter attraction.
- Bjorli is a year-round destination — winter and summer are both core seasons.
- Postal address: Bjorliveien 84, 2669 Bjorli, Norway.

## International flight access

- The closest relevant international airport is Ålesund Airport Vigra (AES).
- The drive from Ålesund Airport Vigra to Bjorli is approximately 2.5 hours.
- KLM operates direct flights between Amsterdam and Ålesund in relevant
  periods, with services scheduled across 2026 according to Travel Trade
  Møre & Romsdal.
- SAS operates direct flights between Copenhagen and Ålesund from
  29 March 2026, including winter 2026/2027, according to Travel Trade
  Møre & Romsdal.
- These routes make Bjorli particularly accessible for Danish and Dutch
  visitors in relevant periods.
- Always verify current schedules with the airline before booking.
